title: What my husky eats from morning to night

lines.text: This is what my husky eats all day.
lines.speaker: host
lines.shot: medium shot, phone held at arm's length: she grins into the camera

lines.text: First up, his lick mat with frozen pumpkin mash.
lines.speaker: host
lines.shot: hard cut: overhead close-up of the lick mat spread with frozen pumpkin mash, the husky working at it; her voice carries on

lines.text: Noon brings a dental stick, nothing fancy.
lines.speaker: host
lines.shot: hard cut: the husky gnawing a dental stick on the kitchen floor

lines.speaker: host
lines.shot: hard cut: she scoops kibble into a steel bowl

lines.text: And the toast crust he stole from my plate.
lines.speaker: host
lines.shot: hard cut back to her medium shot, she raises an eyebrow; behind her the husky trots off with a toast crust

speech.voice: her own warm American voice, close to the phone and clear

taste.voice: a warm American woman of about thirty, described in the prompt
taste.why: All five lines fit a single take, so the video model says them; a soft ukulele bed stays under the voice.

models.why: the leading released image-edit model; held the dog and the products steady across the dry run's frames
one approved AI host image says every line in a single take, with native speech

facts.claim: Plain cooked pumpkin, with no sugar or spice added, is a safe lick-mat filling.
Frozen treats suit dogs in moderation; check shop-bought ones for xylitol.

hits.mitigation: lines in quotes with their times in the prompt; the transcript is compared with the script at the take check
hands only scoop kibble; the prompt asks for no fine finger work
the lick mat enters from its packshot as a reference image (reference mode)
one 14 s take with hard cuts in the prompt; the cuts are checked at the take check

style_spec.layout: a talking-head day recap: she names each meal and B-roll shows it under her voice
style_spec.font_class: platform-native captions, white sans with a soft shadow
extras: an on-screen label naming each meal as it comes up
